source.selection: 90 materials; 9 each from 10 categories; metadata license filtered to CC0
source.input_pipeline: source PBR material -> Blender planar preview render -> RGB crop
source.inference_prompt: category plus automatically estimated dominant color

inference.timing_scope: after model load; includes input decode, inference, and output writes

known_limitations: Rendered highlights and shading can leak into BaseColor or geometry maps.
The v0.5 Prompt taxonomy has no dedicated Wood class; Wood was mapped to Cork.
This run demonstrates coverage and completion, not ground-truth physical accuracy.
